groups.defect: The migration inserts hosts with schemes and paths intact, preventing matches against the bare hostname used by the lookup.
groups.rationale: All three report the same missing normalization before insertion. SQL sanitization appears only in their proposed fixes, so it does not connect them to the SQL-escaping defect group.

groups.defect: The migration dereferences empty category lookup results and interpolates unescaped host values into SQL.
groups.rationale: s_74124a9e explicitly reports both defects, connecting the empty-result reports with the unescaped-insertion report. Both defects must survive in the merged comment.

groups.defect: Update and destroy dereference missing host records, and save_host also dereferences a missing embeddable_host parameter object.
groups.rationale: Every member reports the unchecked record lookup in update and destroy. s_b171a9e5 additionally reports missing request parameters, which the merged comment must retain.

groups.defect: The category and embeddable-host fabricator files contain each other's definitions.
groups.rationale: These describe the same swapped-file defect from its two locations. Correcting it requires restoring the definitions in both files.

groups.defect: The before_validation callback calls sub! on a nil host, raising instead of allowing validation to fail.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same unguarded normalization callback and are resolved by the same nil handling.
